evidence.detail: Exact v308 has one external class consumer of rs/p: rs/x. In its terrain decode path, plane-0 tile heights are written as -8 times rs/p.a(worldX + 932731, worldY + 556238); higher planes derive from the previous plane minus 240 instead of calling rs/p.
rs/p.a(x,y) combines smoothed/interpolated pseudo-random noise at scales 4, 2 and 1 with exact weighting, then applies 35 + 0.3*value and clamps the result to 10..60.
The class owns the complete supporting surface: deterministic coordinate hashing, neighbor-smoothed noise, cosine-interpolated grid sampling, and 2048-entry sine/cosine lookup initialization.
rs/p owns no scene objects, tile arrays, archive state or renderer state; it is a stateless static numeric helper whose live output feeds only base terrain height generation.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the procedural base-terrain height noise utility. No original stripped source identifier is claimed.
